[assistant] **Findings**
1. High: source-specific repo caches now depend on `external_cache` being enabled to discover raw `.py` skills. [`RepoCacheSkillSource.iter_candidates()`](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_sources.py#L168) only calls the importer with `scan_python=False`, and [`_build_sources()`](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_sources.py#L280) only adds the raw-scan fallback via `CacheSweepSkillSource` when `external_cache` is present in priority. That means a policy like `["claude","codex"]` will stop seeing repos that don't ship `skill_candidates.yaml`/`registry.yaml`, even if the repo cloned correctly.

2. Medium: repo sync failures are still silently reported as ordinary misses. [`RepoCacheSkillSource.prepare()`](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_sources.py#L150) and [`RepoCacheSkillSource.prepare()`](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_sources.py#L158) use `subprocess.run(..., check=False)`, and the resolver only marks `source_error` when an exception is raised. A failed `git clone`/`git pull` with nonzero exit code will therefore look like `no_candidate`, which hides auth/network problems and can send the flow to builder unnecessarily.

3. Medium: legacy list-form `install_candidates` entries lose their source metadata during normalization. The dict branch in [`_normalize_registry_data()`](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/skill_registry.py#L75) converts `source`/`source_id` into normalized `source_id`, but the list branch at [`_normalize_registry_data()`](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/skill_registry.py#L81) just copies the item. Later, [`ExternalSkillResolver._build_sources()`](/D:/warkSpaces/agent-factory/core/external_skill_sources.py#L255) defaults missing `source_id` to `registry`, so old list-based registries will collapse Claude/Codex candidates into `registry` and bypass the source-priority behavior you just added.

Assumption: 이번 리뷰는 방금 수정한 external-source/builder/lazy-import 변경 범위 위주로 봤습니다.
